title: Bracket, flow, and a failed surface
promptMarkdown: For $X=\partial_x+y\partial_z$ and $Y=\partial_y$ on $\mathbb R^3$, compute both flows and $[X,Y]$. Calculate the effect of the four moves: flow along $X$ for $s$, along $Y$ for $t$, along $X$ for $-s$, then along $Y$ for $-t$. Use this and the Frobenius criterion to decide whether their rank-two span is integrable.
hintLadder: Write every intermediate point; the coefficient y changes after the second move.
A vector in the span with zero x and y components must vanish.
